## Why PostgREST? {.center}

::: {.r-fit-text}
**Zero Code APIs**
:::

Turn your database schema into a REST API automatically

---

## Traditional API Development

```{mermaid}
graph LR
    A[Database] --> B[Backend Code]
    B --> C[API Routes]
    C --> D[Authentication]
    D --> E[Validation]
    E --> F[Documentation]
    F --> G[Client]
```

::: {.fragment}
**Problems:** Boilerplate code, maintenance overhead, schema sync issues
:::

---

## PostgREST Approach

```{mermaid}
graph LR
    A[PostgreSQL Schema] --> B[PostgREST]
    B --> C[REST API]
    C --> D[Client]
```

::: {.fragment}
**Benefits:** Auto-generated, always in sync, minimal configuration
:::

---

## PostGIS Integration {.smaller}

```sql
-- Enable PostGIS
CREATE EXTENSION postgis;

-- Spatial data types
CREATE TABLE locations (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100),
    geom GEOMETRY(POINT, 4326)
);

-- Spatial queries
SELECT name FROM locations 
WHERE ST_DWithin(geom, ST_Point(-71.0589, 42.3601), 1000);
```

::: {.fragment}
**Result:** Geographic APIs with zero additional code!
:::

## Database Schema → API {.smaller}

```sql
-- Create table
CREATE TABLE workshops (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    duration INTEGER,
    instructor VARCHAR(100)
);

-- Grant permissions
GRANT SELECT ON workshops TO web_anon;
```

::: {.fragment}
**Instantly available:**

- `GET /workshops` - List all
- `GET /workshops?id=eq.1` - Filter
- `GET /workshops?select=title,duration` - Projection
:::

---

## Query Parameters {.smaller}

::: {.fragment}

- **Filtering**
  - /workshops?duration=gt.120
  - /workshops?title=like.*PostgREST*
  - /workshops?instructor=in.(John,Jane)

- **Ordering**
  - /workshops?order=duration.desc

- **Pagination**
  - /workshops?limit=10&offset=20

- **Relationships**
  - /workshops?select=*,participants(`*`)
:::

## JWT Authentication Flow {.smaller}

```sql
-- Create roles
CREATE ROLE authenticator LOGIN;
CREATE ROLE web_anon NOLOGIN;
CREATE ROLE workshop_user NOLOGIN;

-- Login function
CREATE FUNCTION login(email TEXT, password TEXT) 
RETURNS JSON AS $$
  -- Verify credentials and return JWT
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
```

::: {.fragment}
**Usage:**
```bash
curl -X POST /rpc/login \
  -d '{"email":"user@example.com","password":"secret"}'
```
:::


::: {.fragment}
**Setup login, hashing, signup code:**
```bash
check the code at - https://postgrest-ws.rottengrapes.tech/postgrest-auth/
```
:::

---

## Row Level Security {.smaller}

```sql
-- Enable RLS
ALTER TABLE workshops ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Create policy
CREATE POLICY workshop_policy ON workshops
  FOR ALL TO workshop_user
  USING (instructor = current_setting('request.jwt.claims')::json->>'email');
```

::: {.fragment}
**Result:** Users only see their own workshops automatically!
:::

## PostgreSQL Functions → API Endpoints {.smaller}

```sql
-- Function becomes RPC endpoint
CREATE FUNCTION search_workshops(query TEXT)
RETURNS TABLE(id INT, title TEXT, relevance REAL) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT w.id, w.title, 
         similarity(w.title, query) as relevance
  FROM workshops w
  WHERE w.title % query
  ORDER BY relevance DESC;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
```

::: {.fragment}
**API call:**
```bash
POST /rpc/search_workshops
{"query": "PostgREST"}
```
:::

---

## Spatial Functions {.smaller}

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION nearby_locations(
  lat FLOAT, 
  lng FLOAT, 
  radius_meters INT DEFAULT 1000
)
RETURNS TABLE(name TEXT, distance FLOAT) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT l.name, 
         ST_Distance(l.geom, ST_Point(lng, lat)::geography) as distance
  FROM locations l
  WHERE ST_DWithin(l.geom, ST_Point(lng, lat)::geography, radius_meters)
  ORDER BY distance;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
```

## Real-World Spatial Queries {.smaller}

```bash
# Find nearby workshops
POST /rpc/nearby_locations
{"lat": 42.3601, "lng": -71.0589, "radius_meters": 5000}

# Get workshop locations as GeoJSON
GET /locations?select=name,geom&geom=not.is.null

# Find workshops within polygon
POST /rpc/workshops_in_area
{"boundary": "POLYGON((...))"} 
```

::: {.fragment}
**Perfect for:** Maps, location services, delivery apps, IoT
:::

-- Essential indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_workshops_instructor ON workshops(instructor);
CREATE INDEX idx_locations_geom ON locations USING GIST(geom);

## Production Deployment {.smaller}

```yaml
# docker-compose.prod.yml
services:
  postgrest:
    image: postgrest/postgrest
    environment:
      PGRST_DB_URI: ${DATABASE_URL}
      PGRST_JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET}
      PGRST_DB_POOL: 20
    deploy:
      replicas: 3
```

::: {.fragment}
**Also consider:** Kubernetes, AWS ECS, Google Cloud Run
:::

## When NOT to Use PostgREST {.smaller}

::: {.incremental}

- **File processing** - Heavy computational tasks
- **Third-party integrations** - External API orchestration
- **Custom protocols** - Non-HTTP requirements
- **Legacy constraints** - Existing architecture limitations
:::

---

## Best Practices {.smaller}

::: {.incremental}

- **Schema design first** - API follows structure
- **Use views** for complex queries
- **Implement RLS** for security
- **Create indexes** for performance
- **Version your schema** with migrations
- **Monitor query performance** regularly
- **Test with realistic data** volumes
:::
